description: colosseum_probe. WHEN: as attacker, send one conversational probe toward the hidden token. Differs from colosseum_claim (final guess, 2 max), colosseum_defend (defender seat), and colosseum_enter (open match). Side effect: appends a probe turn. Example: colosseum_probe {"match_id":"<match_id>","message":"<message>"}
